'''2004 World Championship''' was a Players Committee constructed World Championship, held at Gen Con in Indianapolis, Indiana.<ref name="awards">[https://www.starwarsccg.org/community/awards/ Awards and Hall of Fame], starwarsccg.org; Wayback [https://web.archive.org/web/20230817222457/https://www.starwarsccg.org/community/awards/ 17 August 2023]</ref> [[Brandon Schele]] defeated [[Reid Smith]].<ref name="awards" />

The constructed pool was printed Decipher cards through [[Theed Palace]] plus original [[Virtual Sets (2002-2009)|Players Committee Virtual Sets]] then legal. A numbered original-VS cutoff for this event is not dested here.

== Format ==

* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS6]] (from the card pool legal on the event date)
* '''Dates:''' 2004
* '''Site:''' Gen Con, Indianapolis, Indiana
* '''Winner:''' [[Brandon Schele]]
* '''Runner-up:''' [[Reid Smith]]
